county: Los Angeles County (historic site at 6400 Bixby Hill Road, Long Beach); the original Mexican grant (GLO No. 468) also spanned land in present-day Orange County (city of Los Alamitos)
notes_on_land_disambiguation: IMPORTANT: The Bixby family operated several ranches. Many Bixby cattle/branding photographs in the Rancho Los Alamitos Foundation collection were taken at NACIMIENTO RANCH (San Luis Obispo/Monterey County) and at COJO / Jalama (Santa Barbara County), NOT at Los Alamitos itself. Los Cerritos is a SEPARATE sister rancho (also Bixby-associated). Each item below states the land it depicts. 'Rancho Santa Margarita' in Orange County and the San Diego 'Santa Margarita y Las Flores' are unrelated to this target and are not included.

Use rights notable: 'The Huntington Library does not require that researchers request permission to quote from or publish images of this material, nor does it charge fees.' Chapman University, Frank Mt. Pleasant Library of Special Collections & Archives - Ed Blatchford Rancho Los Alamitos photographs collection. ArchivesSpace: https://chapman.lyrasistechnology.org/repositories/3/resources/76. One University Drive, Orange, CA 92866.

Historical Society of Long Beach (HSLB) - museum/archive/research center in Bixby Knolls, 4260 Atlantic Ave, Long Beach, CA. Holds 150,000+ Long Beach photographic images, maps, architectural drawings; historically housed at Rancho Los Alamitos and Rancho Los Cerritos. https://hslb.org

Long Beach Public Library - Long Beach History & Special Collections / Digital Photo Archive (100+ years of Long Beach images). https://www.longbeach.gov/library/research/long-beach-history-and-special-collections/
